name: component_target_strategy
description: Deterministic resolution strategy that verified a component PURL against a pinned repository tree.

definitions.shared_release: Package inherits the monorepo release version and matches a shared release tag pointing at the pinned commit (e.g. multi-module Maven POM).
definitions.package_release: Package declares its own version and matches a package-specific release tag pointing at the pinned commit (e.g. LangChain).
definitions.workspace_package: Public workspace member declares its own package name and version independently of a private workspace root (e.g. Pi).

standard.none: Project-defined vocabulary for verified component PURL resolution.
